string-array.name: changelog
string-array.item: New: Sony Ericsson logo icon, now also used for this icon pack app itself
New: 20 glossy 3D icons (Gmail, Drive, Maps, Photos, Keep, Netflix, PlayStation, PSP, Walkman, Sony store, YouTube and more). Pick them in the Glossy - 3D styles section

New: live icons. Clock shows the real time and Calendar shows the current date (Lawnchair, Nova, Kvaesitso and similar launchers; others show a static icon). The calendar follows the date automatically; a calendar you pick by hand in a launcher is always a fixed image, so use Reset to default to get the live one back
New: dynamic clocks (silver, dark, white) can be picked by hand in Lawnchair and stay live
New: dark, silver and white clock dials plus blue calendar icons
Fix: Xperia clock now shows its ticking seconds hand on Android 11 and older too
New: glossy Amazon icon (navy and black styles)
New: "Xperia clock" widget (sharp high-resolution dial), a live brushed-metal analog clock with an orange seconds hand (resizable, tap to open alarms)
New: "Xperia action (dock)" shortcut, the same actions and icons as the widget, and it can be placed in the dock
New: "Xperia action" 1x1 home-screen widget with a customisable icon. Adds an app-drawer button to One UI and runs notifications, quick settings, recents, lock and more
New app icon and in-app header/avatar images: the classic Sony Ericsson logo
New: 3 glossy address-book contacts icons (pick them from the Glossy - Multiple styles section)
New: 206 glossy circular icons (95 classic-era app icons in several versions, plus 111 icons for modern apps)
Apps with several styles: the newest classic icon is the default; tap the icon in your launcher edit menu to choose another style
Classic KitKat and Xperia icons are still included as alternatives
Multiple alternatives for core apps (Phone, Camera, Walkman, WhatsApp, YouTube, Instagram, etc.)
Compatible with Nova Launcher, Lawnchair, Smart Launcher, Niagara, and others
